content.text:
That’s wonderful to hear! Here are emoji ideas to match a happy vibe, plus a few ready-to-send combo options.

Vibe options
- Celebration/excitement: 🎉🥳✨👏
- Bright and sunny: ☀️🌞🌈😊
- Warmth and friendship: 🤗💖💛
- Accomplishment/energy: 🎯🏆🔥
- Playful/cheerful: 😄😆🤪
- Cozy/positive calm: 🌼🧡🌸

Ready-to-send example lines
- “Feeling amazing today! 😄🎉”
- “Good vibes only. ☀️😊🌈”
- “Sending you happy thoughts! 🤗✨”
- “Crushing today! 🏆🔥”
- “Just a sunny mood kind of day. 🌞😄”

If you tell me who you’re texting (a friend, family, coworker, social media caption), I can tailor emoji combos and write a few caption options for you.
